title: Device Authenticate - request  (firmware -> POST /api/Device/Authenticate)
description: The BODY carries nothing: ServiceController::apiAuthenticate() sends an empty ArduinoJson document, which serializes as JSON null. Credentials travel as HTTP HEADERS - 'apiId' and 'apiKey', both the device GUIDs from a prior Register/Config response. The server (DeviceApiController.ReqAuth) reads only those two headers and ignores the body.
$comment: Required request headers (not expressible in JSON Schema, listed here for the contract record): 'apiId': device ApiId GUID; 'apiKey': device ApiKey GUID.
